text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian newspapers this morning.

-Industrifinans Aktiv came on top of the list over the best Norwegian mutual funds last year. The fund achieved 88.7 percent interest on investments, while the Oslo Bourse Total index rose 32.1 percent.
- Only 252 persons died in traffic accidents last year, 53 less than in 1995 and the lowest number since the mid-50s. Drivers are considered more responsible today.
- Norway, which is not a member of the European Union, nonetheless wants the EU to become more involved in the Barents Sea cooperation.
- The Norwegian crown is back on the 1992 levels when it was sent floating. The industry's competitiveness improved considerably then, but has now weakened again.
- After Norway entered the Schengen border agreement with the EU, Norwegian authorities will be forced to accept EU visa and asylum rules.
- Bergesen has won a major contract under which it will ship iron ore and coal for British Steel over a period of 15 years.
- Oslo-based brokerhouse Orkla Finans will open a small office in London this year.
